==  Jay's Brochure ==

[[jbocre: Jay Kominek|Jay Kominek]] has made a [[jbocre: Jay's Lojban Brochure|nice double-sided brochure]] available.

==  CafePress Stores ==

Several lojbanists have made CafePress stores.  Note that, as far as I know, none of the revenues from these stores go to the LLG.
* [http://www.cafeshops.com/cp/store.aspx?s=logfest The LogFest Store] by [[User:Mark Shoulson|Mark Shoulson]].
* [http://www.cafepress.com/logfest2 The Older Items LogFest Store], also by [[User:Mark Shoulson|Mark Shoulson]].
* [http://www.cafeshops.com/cp/store.aspx?s=lojban The Lojban Store] by [[jbocre: Jay Kominek|Jay Kominek]].
* [http://www.cafepress.com/mathomhouse/784511 The Lojban Store At Mathomhouse] by [[jbocre: Hal Fulton|Hal Fulton]].
* [http://www.cafepress.com/vixshop vixshop] by [[User:nonong|Viktor Medrano]].
